source_row.rationale: Dysphagia screening before oral intake is important because stroke can impair swallowing function, and undetected dysphagia significantly increases the risk of aspiration pneumonia, a serious and common post-stroke complication.
source_row.source_detail: Importance of Pre-Oral Intake Dysphagia Screening
